review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no @[simp] lemmas and no simp sets. Its definitions are coproduct, coproductCofan, coequalizer, coequalizerCofork and imageBasicOpen. Its theorems are existence and local-hom lemmas, plus the instance-style theorems. I grepped Mathlib for outside uses of coproductCofan, coequalizerCofork and imageBasicOpen and found none. So there is no downstream simp use that would justify adding simp lemmas for them. The only simp calls are inside proofs: `simp` in coproductCofan naturality and `simp only [...]` in the coproductCofanIsColimit and imageBasicOpen proofs. Those are local, and I saw no sign of a loop, an unsuitable rewrite direction, or competing rules. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out simplifier problems that only show up when compiling.
